notes.title: Join our public playtest for a major new update!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, Residents of Paw Village! 🐾[/h2]

Gosh has it been a while… When we launched [i][b]Kitaria Fables[/b][/i] back in 2021 we honestly had no idea how big this community would eventually become! As of today [b]over 400,000 players[/b] have joined Nyanza and Macaron on their adventures across Canoidera which is a staggering number! We're truly humbled by your support and enthusiasm for the world we created 🥹

So… you might be wondering what we've been doing for the last few years. Well, while we're not quite ready to reveal what we've been working on [b]JUST YET (more news on this shortly…)[/b] we are excited to be launching a surprise new update for Kitaria Fables in April which adds a tonne of quality of life and balance changes to make your adventures in Kitaria better than ever before! 

Before we release the update to everyone across all platforms, we'll be running a [b]public playtest[/b] of the new content here on Steam, starting today and [b]running until Monday, March 31st.[/b] Read on to find out precisely what's included and how you can help us out by joining the testing team 🥳 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/f82c58545971325dc7e85423754f98ff6c28cf5e.jpg[/img] 

[h3][b]Quality of life improvements[/b][/h3]

We spent a lot of time going through all of your feedback since launch and we identified a number of key areas which we have addressed as follows: 

[b]Improvements to the overworld map:[/b] We've added a bunch of visual improvements to the overworld map to make exploration more enjoyable and intuitive. It is now much easier to recognize which locations are linked via pathways. Each location also has a treasure chest counter to let you know how many unopened wooden, copper, silver, and gold chests remain. Most importantly quest availability markers now appear in their associated locations so you'll never get stuck with where you need to go next!

[b]Reducing the grind:[/b] We have upped the % drop rate of materials for a significant proportion of enemies which means that you'll spend less time grinding for the materials you need to craft new equipment and items. To compliment this we've also increased the amount of Paw Pennies that you are awarded for completing main quests, and have increased the sell price for all crafted materials deposited in the sell box by 40%, so you’ll get rich quicker! 

[b]Fast travel points:[/b] Every fast travel point that you discover now supports two-way travel. This will make it much easier to jump between discovered areas and drastically reduce backtracking. On top of this, the entire fast travel ‘network’ has been reworked to focus on key towns and areas which will feel much more logical.

[b]Resting and time of day:[/b] As there are a number of in-game mechanics that make use of the time of day feature, we've expanded the options for resting so that you can now pick to skip forward to either 7 am, 12 noon, and 6 pm when you rest at Thunderbunn Farm.
   
[h3][b]Balance changes[/b][/h3]

[b]Difficulty modes:[/b] Originally we had a single fixed difficulty which has now been replaced with four different modes which can be changed at any time via the pause menu. Each mode scales enemy attack and defense values to accommodate different player skill levels. 

[b]Changes to the bow weapon:[/b] Bows were a little bit underpowered, so we have buffed their damage stat to be more aligned with sword weapons. This means that magic damage calculation is much fairer for bow users who were previously penalised due to the difference in attack values. 

[b]Enemy status effects:[/b] We have debuffed the stun, freeze, and poison effects so that you recover faster and therefore spend less time waiting around.

[h3][b]Miscellaneous[/b][/h3] 

[b]Controller vibration support:[/b] Your attacks and spells will feel much more powerful, and you'll notice the rumbling footsteps of bigger monsters and bosses.

[b]On boot options:[/b] You can now select your language and brightness preferences.

Alongside the above changes are various other minor bug fixes including an issue in co-op mode where one player could get locked out of the battle area 🙀  

[h3][b]How to participate in the public playtest[/b][/h3]

Anyone can join the playtest by following these steps:

[olist]
[*] Right-click on the Kitaria Fables app in your Steam library.
[*] Select properties.
[*] Select betas.
[*] In the private betas access code box enter the password: MonsterPudding and click check code. This will unlock the beta branch 2025-update - Public test branch for version 2.0.
[*] In the beta participation dropdown select 2025-update - Public test branch for version 2.0.   
[*] Select installed files and click the 'verify integrity of game files' button to make sure that your game is updated! 
[*] If you ever need to switch back to the main app simply go back to the betas page and select 'none' from the dropdown.
[/olist]
We'd greatly appreciate any and all feedback that you have relating to the new changes we've made so we've created a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1356280/discussions/0/599646660884229956/]new feedback thread in the Steam forum[/url], and a new channel on [url=https://discord.gg/Z4DsQjMsFA]the official discord.[/url] Do let us know your thoughts or if you encounter any issues!

As we mentioned at the start of the post, we've got more news incoming so stay tuned for that, but until then we really hope you'll enjoy the update!

Until next time, 

PQube, Twin Hearts, and Secret Level Studios.

notes.title: Controller Update Version 1.0.0.9
notes.content:
- Optimized and fixed some issues with the controller input system
- The settings "Open Inventory Menu," "Open Pause Menu," "UI Select," and "UI Back/Close" will no longer be adjustable to prevent locking the player out of some functions accidentally
- Fixed movement and selection that used analog input from being modified from controller mapping

Due to several reworks on the controller input system, this update will reset your previous controller mapping settings to default. This will also resolve an issue that players cannot open the menu or have missing inputs in their mappings.

We have purchased and tested the majority of reported joysticks in coop mode. Oddly enough, controller support works perfectly on a non-steam version of Kitaria Fables, and only the Steam version caused issues with some Bluetooth gamepads.

Steam creates a virtual gamepad for all connected gamepads based on their configuration, so this is the approach we took to solve the issue:
1. When you connect your Bluetooth gamepad, make sure to wait until it is displayed as a gamepad instead of a keyboard or any other device, then connect. (T3 Terios Bluetooth gamepad, for example) 
2. Go to Steam -> Settings -> Controller -> General Controller Settings -> Check the Guide Button Focuses Steam and Generic Gamepad Configuration Support and uncheck the rest.
3. It should be detected as a generic gamepad on the detected controller at controller settings. Click it, then click Define Layout.
4. Wait until the Steam Overlay message "Gamepad Loaded" shows up, then the Bluetooth Gamepad should work.
5. Try to run the game!

List of joysticks we have tested:
- Logitech F310 Wired and Wireless
- Logitech F710 Wireless
- DualShock 4
- DualSense
- T3 Terios Gamepad
- 8Bit do
- Xbox One
- Xbox Series S

Thank you!

[b]11 x Vengeful [strike]Souls[/strike]
1 - 2 x Magic [strike]Orbs[/strike]

notes.title: Meet the Developers!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/10e4ad195c77a6a6f190dee1919a124ee390dfcf.png[/img]

Hi Everyone, 

We're so glad to see that so many of you have been enjoying the Kitaria Fables Demo at Steam #NEXTFEST! For those of you who have encountered Kitaria Fables for the first time this week - and those who have been following Nyanza and Macaron for months! - we prepared a quick Q&A with developers Twin Hearts. 

We hope you enjoy reading!

- PQube Team 


[h3][b]Firstly - Please introduce us to yourself and your development team![/b][/h3]

[h3][i]"Hello! We are Twin Hearts from Yogyakarta, Indonesia. Our team consists of three people - Yogie as the lead game designer and programmer; Yossy as the 2D and 3D artist; and RaGal as the game designer and story writer."[/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/9ca0ca9762ed1120baaa2860c74ddd021da22ae8.png[/img]

[h3][b]How long has Kitaria Fables been in development?[/b][/h3]

[i][h3]"We’ve been working on Kitaria Fables for just over 2 and a half years. In that time we’ve tried to implement lots of content and change and adjust elements until we found the best combination for the combat system, RPG elements, art & environment. It’s been quite a journey!"[/h3][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/21665b575bc43c6f015ec13743ee9c51f7f38326.gif[/img]

[h3][b]What existing games does Kitaria Fables take inspiration from? [/b][/h3]

[i][h3]"Games such as Rune Factory were one of our main inspirations when creating Kitaria Fables. We want to give players a similar experience - but with a simplified farming system and a greater emphasis on combat."[/h3][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/e55f4eeffd23b282f04137d256d8b4b7d1d432e2.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]In your own words, tell us a little about what we can expect from Kitaria Fables?[/b][/h3]

[i][h3]"As a fan of RPG and simulation games, we tried to mix and match some RPG elements with a farming system. We didn't try to make it too complicated and we hope that players enjoy it!"[/h3][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/6d6cbc63a2611130b69dbddb74dbe6c665afcbf1.png[/img]

[h3][b]Kitaria Fables combines farming with traditional RPG elements like crafting, exploration and combat. What rewards or benefits will players get for growing crops and tending to their plot of land?  [/b][/h3]

[i][h3]"The main purpose of the farming system is to supply players with necessities. Harvested crops can be used to replenish health or to cook meals to boost attributes. Alternatively, you can simply place crops in the selling box to gain money!"[/h3][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/ab1890def6d27eb28ff86adf27abc839da2bae2c.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Can you tell us more about how the combat will work in Kitaria Fables?[/b][/h3]

[i][h3]"In Kitaria Fables there is no class system - the player is free to use either a sword or bow. There are also magic skills for both weapon types and the ability to cast spells with 4 magic elements and unique debuff, status, ailments and effects. With such freedom and skill variety, players can follow their own combat style and switch it up at any time."[/h3][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/db526a2656768f01d3c7de31c689dc5d28c3c3b4.gif[/img]

[h3][b]What role does magic play in Kitaria Fables? [/b][/h3]

[i][h3]"In the story, magic is prohibited by The Empire. Anyone caught performing magic will be arrested. But little do they know, the cause of the rising darkness in Kitaria is magic powers, and it only can be countered by other magic powers. Our main character currently doesn't know it, but they possess this power…

Once they learn about it, they will be able to fight back the ferocious monsters and help bring back peace to the land."[/h3][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/de9d3dfce918ac3b359f0a84a606768c3319b83b.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Kitaria Fables is full of rich, appealing environments. Can you tell us about the inspirations behind the art and environments in the game? [/b][/h3]

[i][h3]"We love the lively and vibrant environments in games such as Fantasy Life. Our aim was to keep things simple, but use good colour selection and good object placement in each area to create a rich world environment. We hope players agree that the game world looks rich and alive - but at the same time is easy to navigate."[/h3][/i] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/3bb445030d3149a4741c181bccfebfb903bf21cc.png[/img]

[h3][b]Kitaria Fables is full of friendly - and not so friendly! - citizens. Do you have a personal favourite character?[/b][/h3]

[i][h3]"My personal favorite is Macaron! Full of expression and fun to write...and says whatever is on their mind!"[/h3][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/ce717ffcd7dcd4a79c6723b5e60dca6b85d8187c.png[/img]

[h3][b]Finally - Do you have any hints or tips for players when they first start to explore Paw Village and the world of Kitaria? [/b][/h3]

[i][h3]"The land is quite big, so I suggest exploring it slowly, from the nearest to the farthest (the further you go, the more ruthless the monsters get!). Don't forget to visit the nearby blacksmiths constantly to upgrade your equipment and craft new spells whenever you're ready.

Remember though, there's no need to rush anything, and I hope you'll be able to enjoy the game to the fullest!"[/h3][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/d5029cc87e78d37b7e3444ca4814d2a58be54d9e.png[/img]

[h3][b]We know that a rising darkness is changing the once-peaceful lands around Paw Village. Can you tell us a little about what players must do to uncover the truth behind these events? 
[/b][/h3]

[i][h3]"Follow your heart! [b]*wink*[/b]"[/h3][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/898ae6f43b78c2f746fb6b4e366b0d17853e5fbe.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Weild a Forbidden Magic
[/b][/h3]Embarking on your quest for the very first time, the mysterious and notorious Sage Alby reluctantly shares wisdom from an ancient spell book, introducing you to the lost art of magic. 

Harness the elements of fire, water and wind, learning the old ways of a magic outlawed by The Empire long ago! With a huge range of skills to learn, collect 'spell spheres' to trade with the Sage to unlock new spells.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/6d1438c4fffb9241e13216320789f5af16becaa0.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Fight Side-by-Side With a Friend
[/b][/h3]
Kitaria Fables features local co-op, and remote play via Steam! Team up with a friend, double your firepower and face the dark creatures & dangerous enemies of the wildlands. 

Balance your party with the highly customisable loadout and combat mechanics; from sending in a point-blank heavy hitter while casting spells from afar, to flanking enemies hard with two close range bruisers, and more - the choice is yours!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/8ca27be2f8f64f9494b9edb0dc2912da7f811e03.png[/img]

Check out #KitariaFables and [url=https://twitter.com/KitariaFables]@KitariaFables[/url] on Twitter!

notes.title: Location Spotlight – Upfield River
notes.content:
[h3]Let's take a closer look at one of the first locations you'll encounter in Kitaria Fables. Upfield River on the outskirts of Paw Village! [/h3]

The world of Kitaria is vast and varied. One minute you’ll find yourself scaling snowy mountains, the next in secret lakes, hidden deep in lush forests. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/5d5ede5b255cbb4459bc45853e361466ce061fde.gif[/img]
The first place to familiarize yourself with upon arriving to Paw Village is [i][b]Upfield River[/b][/i]. Surrounded by different fields and plains, your first task in this area is recovering Timmy’s lost backpack. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/007e3c5cf542c00a260b278b660732e6fb40ca06.gif[/img]

[b][h3]Field Foes[/h3]
[/b]Timmy lost his pack as the local creatures have been acting strange and increasingly hostile. You’ll need to be careful of the roads ahead, which are teaming with a variety of foes. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/ca9c8b88a4dd79dd306ad5932874465d8421d878.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/c08e81bb469dd9919d0d9c4dce7b1f32afe80e25.gif[/img]

[b][h3]Snatch and Grab.[/h3]
[/b]You’ll need to fight your way through the swarm of bees and orcs at Byriver Field in order to find Timmy's lost bag. Then it’s back to Paw Village to hand it in!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/1dfe8ad4980071b8522ec0d697a9c1a8bb28b54d.gif[/img]

[b][h3]Where to, Nyanza?[/h3]
[/b]From here, your adventure will take you beyond Paw Village and Upfield River. Will you head into the Forest Sanctuary next? Farm yourself some rare drops from the local creatures? Or give your hand at a spot of farming? That choice is entirely up to you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/dba341a4dfb3888780dcf8a9e57f3d5004b3a121.gif[/img]

That’s all for this week. Stay tuned to our weekly updates where we’ll be diving into weapons and combat, magic and spells, and more of the towns and cities of Canoidera. 

Want more Kitaria? Make sure to check us out over on [url=https://twitter.com/kitariafables]Twitter[/url], as well as our [url=https://pqube.co.uk/kitaria-fables/]website[/url]. 
Join the PQube [url=https://discord.gg/XvbemFHW]Discord[/url] to stay up to date with news of all our titles.

notes.title: Ready yourself - it's time to fight!
notes.content:
Before the Calamity, towns and cities were safe and living in peace. Now, a mysterious darkness hangs over the land, bringing monsters, creatures, and a whole host of problems for the residents of Canoidera. It’s your job to keep these people safe. How you do so…is up to you.

[h3][b]Trust In Your Sword
[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/0dac66422a0452def4cff5092cfc76bda991025e.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/712ab608434de8c2c99353cd25d24a5f04b970c5.gif[/img]
Your starting weapon seems meagre at first, but can grow to become one of  your strongest companions. Fully upgradable via the Smithy’s found around the world, as well as variants looted from fallen foes and found in secret chests, your sword is the bread and butter of combatting the wilds. From simple upgrades like damage and penetration, to status effects and crit multipliers. Skills can also be assigned to your sword as they are learned, allowing you to perform some unstoppable combos.

[h3][b]A Good Defence is the Best Offence
[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/666a1147a8142ea95080ce95f234c9cdce34fc04.gif[/img]
Attacking isn’t all you’ll need to master to be victorious in combat. Often a single blow from a foe is enough to down our adventurer, so a well-timed tactical roll not only saves you from damage, but opens up your enemy to attack. Keep on your toes!

[h3][b]Pick Them Off From Afar!
[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/11339a2066f6ed458dbee7a0e68a899925f0c5de.gif[/img]
Melee combat not your thing? Keep your distance and crush your foes from long range! Bows, much like your sword, can be upgraded to more powerful variants at the Smithy, as well as found scattered around the world. Whether it’s a charged shot, raining from above or some rapid fire – the bow also has a range of skills that can be assigned to give you the edge in combat.

[h3][b]Lookin’ Good As New![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/7549b7564953dddfe519b6a73372f7db8fb92a09.gif[/img]
Whether it’s an upgrade to a piece of gear or crafting something entirely new – there’s always a reason to visit the Smithy. From crafting new armour raising your hit points and defence, to backpieces, helmets and accessories sporting an array of different stat bonuses – there’s a combination for every play style. 

Every foe in Canoidera drops valuable, and sometimes rare, ingredients or crafting components. Store these in your inventory back on Thunerbunn Farm to begin saving for your next big upgrade. 

Thanks for supporting Kitaria Fables! Remember that you can also stay updated by [url=https://twitter.com/kitariafables]following us on our Twitter[/url].

notes.title: Welcome to Thunderbunn Farm!
notes.content:
Even residents in the world of Kitaria need their down time, and that includes you! Having your very own home in the town of Paw Village, passed down from generation to generation, take advantage of the farmland, wardrobe, training area and storage facilities available to you!

[h3][b]Hone Your Skills
[/b][/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/65bf48bd92dc5ad740c0f8e47657c3f69ef34826.gif[/img]
Just North of your farmland, you have access to the training area. Want to practice combos with a new weapon you just purchased? Test out some new magic you learned? Or just want to relieve some stress? The training area is always available - perfect your combat and experiment with new spells to prepare you for the challenges ahead!

[h3][b]Farm to Your Hearts Content
[/b][/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/aceaf039b1f13dcc5dd381349f9805ffadc1f5f4.gif[/img]
Next to your home is your very own plot of farmland! Sew seeds, tend to your crops and harvest the fruits of your labour to use as ingredients for cooking, or sell them off for coin! Make sure to water your crops each day to ensure they fully grow.

[h3][b]Backpack – Check!
[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/4b41ab3c7495a3e6d449490f3eeb7a30a021f8b9.gif[/img]
Between questing, farming your crops and dungeon crawling – you’ll amass a variety of items, loot and crops that you’ll need to manage. Thunberbunn farm gives you access to a starting chest – where you can keep your farming tools and more valuable items – with the option to build more storage as you gather more raw materials. Make sure to always keep your most essential items in your backpack so they are available to you when you’re out in the world!

[h3][b]You're Looking Sharp![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/1704476e42b35427970af37dfe5e6800bf34643e.gif[/img]
With a variety of skins available from the beginning of the game, you’re sure to find the look that suits you best before you head out!

[h3][b]Time to Turn In
[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/d3c1e2002ee67b95f2a0ba234b6c137beb897fe0.gif[/img]
Once nightfall arrives, the town winds down, the stores begin to close as the residents head home, and more dangerous monsters appear in the wilds. Even the most ambitious adventurer needs a good rest! Sleeping restores your health to max and you’ll awaken at dawn – ready for another day of quests, farming and adventures!

Thanks for supporting Kitaria Fables! Remember that you can also stay updated by [url=https://twitter.com/kitariafables?lang=en]following us on our Twitter[/url].

notes.title: Welcome to the world of Kitaria!
notes.content:
[i]Hi Everyone! 

[b]Kitaria Fables[/b] is an indie passion project from lead developer Yogie Aditya and his team at [b]Twin Hearts Games[/b]. It combines action RPG, adventure and farming sim elements, all set within the cute world of Kitaria. Expect real time combat, exploration and dungeoneering - as well as farming for provisions, crafting weapons and forging new spells to increase your power!
 
We're thrilled to be bringing Kitaria Fables to Steam in 2021 - and we'll have much more news, previews and gameplay to share with you soon. In the meantime, we've rounded up a few useful links below! 
 
Follow Kitaria Fables on social media:
[b][url=http://twitter.com/kitaria-fables]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/KitariaFables/]Facebook[/url]
[url=https://www.instagram.com/kitariafables/]Instagram[/url][/b]
 
You can also follow PQube Indies on:
[b][url=http://twitter.com/PQubeIndies]Twitter[/url]
[url=http://facebook.com/PQubeIndies]Facebook[/url][/b]

Thanks for your support! Read on below to find out a little more about Kitaria Fables!

- PQube & Twin Hearts[/i]

==

Kitaria Fables is a delightfully cute fusion of Action RPG, Adventure and Farming Sim! Enter the cute world of Kitaria and take on the quests of your animal neighbours as they face a rising tide of darkness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/7eb8506d77e0f07ffe3b89b07c41b2306f002710.jpg[/img]

Real time combat, exploration and dungeoneering sit alongside farming for provisions and the crafting of weapons and armour, and forging new spells to increase your power. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/bf1d3b1a2e222c240ba223c185dde4b45f46d0cd.jpg[/img]

Make your way to your Uncle's home in Paw Village and from your new base, explore the huge world teaming with wildlife, resources and loot to help you in the long journey ahead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/649f918ee3bab3e1b9679e37edae5a89dbd9986e.jpg[/img]

Wield melee weapons and bows while forging new spells in class-free combat. Kit your loadout in a way which suits your preferred style of battle and craft magic, weapons and armour which compliment your play style.

You'll need much more than brute strength and magic to survive the coming darkness. The lands of Canoidera are full of resources for you to use to your advantage. Slay monsters for ingredients, plant seeds and tend to your crops for provisions and gather materials and ores to craft more powerful weapons, armour and accessories.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/dbb11c510c69b1444af400c4f7a1f81efcf71e8a.jpg[/img]

The world of Kitaria is full of friendly (and not so friendly!) citizens. Make yourself known to your neighbours and fulfil their requests. The more you bond with your new friends, the more rewards you will receive as your relationships grow!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38760320/18b98fdab604dd3faabe0021b0dce7c1274f4e9d.jpg[/img]
